二十号早上，林川早早醒了过来。

窗帘没拉严，一道光从缝隙里斜进来，打在地板上。他盯了一会儿天花板，翻身坐起来，先拿手机拨了江城的号。

响了两声，林母就接了。

“川子，你今天去带小冉报到吗？”

“嗯，今天去。”

“那行，你记得，她书包里有盒药，治感冒的，你帮她放好，别让她自己找。还有你记得叫她多吃点，她从小就瘦——”

“妈，她十八了。”

“十八怎么了，十八也是我孩子。”

林川没反驳，只说了句“知道了”，林父在旁边插进来一句：“川子，多照看着点，上海那么大，别让她乱跑。”

又叮嘱了一会儿，才挂掉电话。

林川把手机放到床头，起身洗漱换衣服。米色的休闲衬衫，深灰色的直筒裤，手腕上的表也没戴，整个人看上去很普通，就是个正常年轻人。

楼下，宾利停在车位上，黑漆在早晨的光里反着一层冷光泽。发动引擎，V12的低鸣从脚底透上来，他把车开出小区，往林小冉的公寓方向走。

林小冉已经在楼下等着了。

“哥！我以为你八点来呢，还没到八点——”

“早点出发，学校今天人多。”林川下车，弯腰把她行李箱拎起来，单手搬进后备箱，

林小冉拉开副驾驶的门坐进去，书包抱在怀里，一路上嘴就没停。

“哥，上财大不大啊？”

“挺大的，你慢慢摸路。”

“宿舍几个人一间啊？”

“四人间，应该。”

林川侧眼看了她一下：“不习惯去住房子，两边随你选，你自己决定。”

林小冉拽着书包带愣了一秒，然后慢慢把嘴闭上了。

到了上财门口，人已经多了。

迎新横幅拉得到处都是，志愿者举着指示牌站在路口，学生和家长带着大包小包往里涌，行李箱滚轮声噼里啪啦响成一片。

林川把车停好，帮林小冉把行李箱拉出来，一手拉着箱子，一手帮她把书包背带理顺，然后跟着人流往里走。

林小冉走在他旁边，一边东张西望一边小声说：“哥，好多人啊……”

“刚开学都这样，进去就好了。”

报到处在学院楼前面搭的棚子下，几张桌子，几摞表格，两三个老师在后面坐着。林川帮林小冉把证件材料都理好，让她站着，他去窗口先问清楚流程。

窗口旁边正好也有几个家长带着孩子在等。

旁边站着一个烫卷发的女人，穿着一件宝蓝色的连衣裙，手里拎着个品牌手提包，旁边站着个看上去跟林小冉差不多大的女孩。

她一边回头叫女儿签名，一边眼神往林川这边飘了一下。

然后又飘了一下。

林川没注意，低头帮林小冉在一张报名表上找到正确的填写栏，用圆珠笔指了一下：“这里，写全名。”

那个女人就在旁边开口了，语气听不出是对谁说的，但声量控制得刚好够旁边的人听见：

“现在的小年轻真讲究，送个报到跟走秀似的。”

林小冉手顿了一下。

林川没抬头，继续看表格。

那女人见没人搭，又补了一句，声音里头带了点意思：“也是，有这条件，当哥哥的可不得好好撑场面。”

林小冉脸色变了变，想说什么，却又不太说得出口。她从小就这样，哪怕是委屈的时候，也是那种很快把情绪往里咽的性子。

但这一次，林川把圆珠笔放下了。

他转过头，看了那女人一眼，带着一丝讥笑道，

“这大清早的，哪儿来的苍蝇。”

那女人眼睛一瞪，正要开口，棚子侧边走过来一个人。

穿着白色的短袖pOlO，校徽印在左胸口，扎着简单的马尾，脸上没怎么打粉，就是那种不用打粉的漂亮。

看着二十三四的样子，走路很快，手里夹着一摞表格。

“家长同学们，现在人比较多，大家先按顺序来，有问题可以找我，我是院系的辅导员。”

On the morning of the 20th, Lin Chuan woke up early.

The curtains were not drawn tightly, and a ray of light slanted in through the gap and hit the floor.He stared at the ceiling for a while, then turned over and sat up. He first took his cell phone and dialed Jiang Cheng's number.

After two rings, Mother Lin answered the call.

"Kawako, are you going to take Xiao Ran to check in today?"

"Well, let's go today."

"Okay, remember, there is a box of medicine in her schoolbag to treat colds. You put it away for her and don't let her find it by herself. And remember to tell her to eat more, she has been thin since she was a child-"

"Mom, she's eighteen."

"What's wrong with Shiba? Shiba is also my child."

Lin Chuan didn't refute, just said "I know", and Lin's father intervened: "Kuanzi, take more care of her, Shanghai is so big, don't let her run around."

After urging him for a while, he hung up the phone.

Lin Chuan put his phone on the bedside and got up to wash up and change clothes.Wearing a beige casual shirt, dark gray straight pants, and no watch on his wrist, he looked very ordinary, just a normal young man.

Downstairs, the Bentley was parked in the parking space, the black paint reflecting a cold sheen in the morning light.Starting the engine, the low roar of the V12 came through from the soles of his feet. He drove the car out of the community and walked towards Lin Xiaoran's apartment.

Lin Xiaoran is already waiting downstairs.

"Brother! I thought you were coming at eight o'clock, but it's not even eight o'clock yet—"

"Leave early, the school is crowded today." Lin Chuan got off the car, bent down to pick up her suitcase, and moved it into the trunk with one hand.

Lin Xiaoran opened the passenger door and sat in, holding her schoolbag in her arms, and kept talking all the way.

"Brother, is it a big deal to make a fortune?"

"It's quite big. You need to take your time to find your way."

"How many people are there in the dormitory?"

"Quadruple room, probably."

Lin Chuan glanced at her sideways and said, "If you're not used to living in a house, it's up to you to choose either side. You decide for yourself."

Lin Xiaoran was stunned for a second while holding on to her schoolbag strap, and then slowly closed her mouth.

When we arrived at the gate of Shangcai, there were already many people.

Welcome banners were spread everywhere, volunteers stood at the intersection holding signs, students and parents rushed in with large and small bags, and the sound of suitcase rollers made a loud noise.

Lin Chuan parked the car and helped Lin Xiaoran pull out the suitcase. He held the suitcase with one hand and straightened out her schoolbag strap with the other, and then followed the flow of people inside.

Lin Xiaoran walked beside him, looking around and whispering: "Brother, there are so many people..."

"It's been like this since the beginning of school, just go in and it'll be fine."

The registration office is under a shed set up in front of the college building, with a few tables, a few stacks of forms, and two or three teachers sitting behind it.Lin Chuan helped Lin Xiaoran organize all the identification materials and asked her to stand while he went to the window to ask about the process first.

There happened to be several parents waiting with their children next to the window.

Standing next to her was a woman with permed and curly hair, wearing a royal blue dress and carrying a brand handbag. Next to her stood a girl who looked about the same age as Lin Xiaoran.

As she turned around to ask her daughter to sign, her eyes drifted towards Lin Chuan.

Then it floated again.

Lin Chuan didn't pay attention. He lowered his head to help Lin Xiaoran find the correct column on a registration form and pointed with a ballpoint pen: "Here, write your full name."

The woman spoke right next to her. Her tone was hard to tell who she was speaking to, but her volume was controlled just enough for the people next to her to hear:

"Young people nowadays are really particular about it. Giving a check-in is like walking in a catwalk."

Lin Xiaoran paused.

Lin Chuan didn't look up and continued to read the form.

Seeing that no one was available, the woman added another sentence with a hint of meaning in her voice: "Yes, with this condition, the elder brother can't hold on to the scene."

Lin Xiaoran's expression changed. She wanted to say something, but she couldn't quite say it.She has been like this since she was a child. Even when she feels wronged, she has the temperament to swallow her emotions quickly.

But this time, Lin Chuan put down the ballpoint pen.

He turned his head, glanced at the woman, and said with a hint of sneer,

"Where did the flies come from so early in the morning?"

The woman's eyes widened and she was about to speak when a man walked over from the side of the shed.

Wearing a white short-sleeved pOlO, the school badge is printed on the left chest, with a simple ponytail, and her face is not powdered, she is the kind of beauty that does not require powdering.

Looking at twenty-three-four, he was walking very fast with a stack of forms in his hand.

"Parents and students, there are more people now. Please come in order first. If you have any questions, you can come to me. I am the counselor of the department."
